subject: Vendor onboarding passport: DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor disclosure
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@auroratech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@auroratech.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Required vendor paperwork to complete PO

Hi Marissa,

We're getting close to issuing the PO for the pilot (PO will reference Redwood deal ID DEAL-4872). Procurement needs our standard security/privacy packet to complete vendor creation. Can you send over: DPA (signed or DocuSign link acceptable), the latest SOC 2 report or a link to it, and a subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred). Also please confirm billing name and remittance instructions so we can map the PO.

Target timeline from procurement is EOD Wednesday (6/16) to stay on our quarter close. Let me know if that's feasible.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager
AuroraTech

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@auroratech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Required vendor paperwork to complete PO

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up. We're happy to prioritize this so you can get the PO out this week. See the checklist below and what I'll attach/send by EOD tomorrow: 

- DPA: we'll send our standard DPA (PDF) and a DocuSign link for execution. If you have procurement redlines, please flag them now so legal can triage.
- SOC 2: we cannot attach the full report in thread, but we will provide a secure link (time-limited) to the report and the auditor statement.
- Subprocessors: CSV export (name, function, country, data access type).
- Billing: Redwood Inference, Inc. / EIN ending 3421 / wire and ACH instructions in billing stub. Ben (cc) will confirm remittance and PO acceptance path.

Ben — can you confirm our remittance instructions and whether we need any special PO language for AuroraTech?

Sam — note that Karthik (security/legal) may request a specific subprocessor attestation for any restricted data flows; I'll loop him in if needed.

I'll attach: Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf (unsigned), Redwood_Billing_Stub.pdf. Then follow with DocuSign link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments (to follow): Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf, Redwood_Billing_Stub.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@auroratech.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Required vendor paperwork to complete PO

On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 1:04 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Sam — thanks for the heads up...

Hi all — quick note from security/legal: the DPA template Marissa referenced is acceptable for AuroraTech's pilot scope but we need either: (a) a completed subprocessor CSV with fields for data classification and whether the subprocessor has access to live PII, or (b) a separate attestation for processors that only see aggregated/non-identifiable data.

Also: please provide the SOC 2 auditor name and a link to the report (or the report's table of contents). If AuroraTech prefers not to share the full report, a bridge letter or SOC 2 Type II auditor statement is usually sufficient for procurement.

Operationally: procurement should include the PO number in the subject line of the invoice and email the AP team at ap@redwoodinference.com. For expedited processing we can accept an emailed invoice + PO PDF attachment and our AP team will tag it for same-day review when the PO amount is below $50k. 

I'll review the DPA once the DocuSign link is available and confirm any minor redlines within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@auroratech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@auroratech.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -07:00

- Attached: AuroraTech_Subprocessors_20270616.csv (contains name, function, country, access-level).
- Attached: AuroraTech_SOC2_Report_Link.txt (we included a secure S3 link and auditor contact).
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-id-auroratech-dpa (executive-signed on our side).
- PO: Procurement will issue PO #AT-2027-339 by end of day tomorrow once we receive the executed DPA link. Please confirm Redwood's acceptance once the DPA is signed (DocuSign will notify).

Billing confirmation per Ben's note: payee will be Redwood Inference, Inc., invoices to AP at ap@redwoodinference.com. Total pilot value is ~$18,500; please indicate the PO number on the invoice PDF.

If Karthik needs any additional attestation for specific subprocessors, let me know and I can have those teams prepare a one-page statement. Appreciate the help — we look forward to getting the pilot scheduled next week.

Best,
Sam Patel

AuroraTech
